subject: alt-c-pg
title: ALT.C.PG.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart on book p. 319 (PCC-3). ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From the subject: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: RE-ST (restructuralism), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). PR-TRS is on a dotted line from ALT-F. From RE-ST: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From INFO-DE-B: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) is on a dotted line from PROJ-DY.
